name: HoldHeave
_intent: Carrying a big bowl (2.6 across, 1.1 tall) LEVEL OVERHEAD in both hands (seen from the chase camera behind the player): arms up, elbows slightly bent, each palm cupping the bowl's bottom edge from outside-below, the two hands at the same height and the same distance apart all loop; knees soft, a slow breathing bob.
_reference: carrying a full tray / pot overhead; 2.0 s loop, breaths at frames 15 and 45
